artworks.title: Baby in Pink Dress with Roses
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing. They have blue eyes, finely spaced eyebrows, and blonde hair styled close to the head. The person is wearing a light pink dress with a ruffled collar, puffed short sleeves, red scalloped trim at the hem and sleeves, and matching pantaloons with red trim. They have vibrant yellow shoes with floral designs and are holding a bouquet of colorful flowers with their right hand. The background is black.

artworks.title: Woman with Plumed Hat
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is facing forward, holding a large hat on her head. She has curly, dark hair with ringlets at the sides of her face and delicate facial features. She is wearing a long, brown high-waisted dress with long sleeves and intricate fabric work towards the hem. Over her shoulders, she wears a white lace shawl that drapes down. She carries a small, round handbag with blue and white stripes. The background features green bushes or small trees to the right and a slightly clouded blue sky.

artworks.title: The Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg Seated in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image features two figures seen from head to toe. The larger figure is seated and appears to be holding the smaller figure on their lap. The seated figure has their head slightly tilted towards the child and is wearing a robe with intricate patterns and a headscarf. The child has curly hair and is dressed in a simple, flowing garment, holding a long object. Both figures have radiant halos around their heads. In the background, there is a depiction of a natural scene with trees and possibly a building or structure faintly visible to the right. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic, etched style, with lines creating shading and texture.

artworks.title: Mississippi Bear
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear on a rocky ledge in a forested landscape. The bear, depicted in profile, stands on a rocky outcrop that overlooks a deep gorge or valley. The fur of the bear is textured and detailed, surrounded by lush trees with intricate leaves. The scene conveys the wild and rugged nature of the bear's environment, with bushes and small plants dotting the ground. The drawing is monochromatic, but the shading and line work create a vivid image of the bear in its natural habitat.

artworks.title: Anne 1921
artworks.description: This is a portrait sketch of a young girl from 1921. The drawing shows her head and shoulders. She is facing directly forward with a direct gaze. Her features include large eyes, a small nose, and a slightly pouty mouth. The girl has long, dark, wavy hair with straight bangs. She wears a garment with a high rounded collar. The sketch is primarily in grayscale using various shading techniques. The background is plain with no additional elements. At the bottom, there is handwriting that includes the name 'Anna,' the year '1921,' and a signature by the artist.

artworks.title: Woman Having Supper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dining scene with a focus on a table setting. The scene depicts an elegantly dressed person seated at a dining table, with a pitcher being poured into a glass by another figure. The table is adorned with plates of food, including fruits and a dish to the side. The setting suggests a fine dining experience, emphasized by the detailed tableware and the attire of those present. The artwork employs muted tones and a delicate interplay of lines to convey a sense of elegance and leisure. This is in the style of early 20th-century European painting.

artworks.title: The Sagot Address
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in an art gallery. Two women are featured prominently, one wearing a black dress with a hat adorned with a feather, and the other in a green dress with a hat decorated with flowers. They are looking at displayed art or illustrations. Other individuals are also present, observing the artworks. The background shows an art shop with a sign reading "ED. SAGOT" above an awning with yellow and orange stripes. The setting is colored in warm hues.

artworks.title: Willows and White Poplars (Saules et peupliers blancs)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape with trees dominating the scene. The viewpoint is from one side of a path or open area, with trees placed across the composition. Close to the viewer, tall trees with dense foliage are sketched using short, textured strokes. To the right, a few slender trees with bare branches stretch upward. The horizon is low with minimal detail suggesting distant land forms or rocks. The sketch is monochrome with various shades of gray, creating a calm atmosphere. The style is loose yet precise, capturing the natural essence of the landscape.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman holding a child at the base of a tree, with an elderly figure beside them. Numerous cherubic figures are around them, some holding hands and others on tree branches. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with buildings on rocky outcrops.

artworks.title: Bien embarassé
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing away from the viewer. The person is leaning to one side with their left hand on the back of their head. They have a narrow face with an angular jawline, sideburns, and close-cropped hair. The person is wearing a dark overcoat and trousers, holding a top hat in their right hand. In the background, there are three wooden signposts pointing in different directions with inscriptions: "LE PEUPLE," "LA PRESSE," and "LA LIBERTÉ." The signs are surrounded by sketched, cloudy textures, and sparse lines suggest a landscape beyond the signposts.

artworks.title: Général P. Mendez Vigo
artworks.description: The image is a lithograph portrait of a man showing his upper body, including the shoulders and head. He is positioned facing forward while slightly turning his head to his left. The man's facial features include a high forehead, pronounced cheekbones, and a long, thin nose. He has short, thin hair and is wearing spectacles. His clothing consists of a dark overcoat with a high collar, a waistcoat, and a necktie. The background is a lightly shaded area transitioning to a stark white, with the artist's signature and the name "P. Mendez de Vigo, Général Espagnol" inscribed below the portrait. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Mariage de l'Époque et du Constitutionnel
artworks.description: The image depicts three full-body figures positioned closely together. On the left, there is a female figure shown in profile, wearing a gown made entirely of a fabric imprinted with the words "LISEZ L'EPOQUE." Her veil, extending down to her feet, matches the gown. Her facial features are exaggerated with a long nose, and she has long, dark hair adorned with a decorative piece. In the center, there is an elderly individual standing facing forward, holding a book in one hand while the other hand is enveloped by the female's hand. His facial expression is worn, his mouth slightly agape, and he wears a cap atop wispy hair. On the right, a stout male figure, also in profile, leans forward with a walking stick. His nose is pronounced, and he wears a cap, a buttoned coat, and carries a bunch of flowers in his breast pocket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Vous n'avez pas besoin de me rappeler ses titres...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men on a beach with a shovel. The two figures are depicted standing on a beach; one is gesturing toward the sea with an outstretched arm, while the other holds a shovel in one hand. The background features rugged rocky formations. The drawing is rendered in a highly illustrative style with fine lines and shading that denote textures in the clothing and natural elements. Below the scene, there is handwritten text.

artworks.title: Charmé de se voir exposé...
artworks.description: The image contains three individuals from the chest up in what seems to be an art gallery. Two men and a woman in Victorian-era attire are visible. The man in the middle has exaggerated facial features and wears a suit. The woman on the left is in profile and wears a bonnet. The man on the right is also in profile and wears a top hat. In the background is a framed painting of a man with similar exaggerated features against a textured backdrop. The illustration is in black and white with fine shading and line work.

artworks.title: Tiens, ma femme, v'la mon portrait...
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in a simple interior setting. One person is standing with their back turned slightly towards the viewer, while the other person is facing them and holding a framed portrait. Both individuals are dressed conservatively, with one wearing a long coat and the other wearing a long dress. An open trunk with fabric and a large picture frame on the wall are also visible in the room.

artworks.title: Je n'ai jamais tant ri qu'a l'enterrement de la fille a Bourdin...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several individuals gathered around a table outdoors. The drawing shows a group of men sitting closely together at a table, engaged in conversation and drinking. The scene has a jovial atmosphere. The background features tree foliage and a lamp post, giving the impression of a park setting. The sketchy style, use of light and shadow, and expressions on the subjects’ faces come together to create a humorous and somewhat satirical tone.

artworks.title: Voila une femme qui, a l'heure solennelle...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white drawing showing four people in an outdoor setting. On the left are two women standing side by side. The woman on the left has her hair pulled back, wearing a long-sleeved dress with a bow at the collar. Beside her, the second woman has her hair in a bun and is wearing a similar dress, with arms crossed and looking to the side. On the right, a seated woman with her back turned, wearing a long dress and holding a child on her lap. The child is facing forward. The chair they are on has curved details. In the background, there are trees and a building with closed shutters, suggesting a shaded outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Avons saisi dito... un pot a eau, sans eau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three men in an indoor setting. The men wear tall hats of the era and are engaged in a scene that appears humorous and satirical. One man is standing with a notebook and pen. Another man holds a teapot or water jug. The third man is gesturing towards an object. The expressions on their faces are exaggerated and comical. The setting includes a chair and the title hints at a legal or justice theme. The line work and shading are skillful, capturing textures of the clothing and objects.

artworks.title: Faut-y faire une lettre pour l'attendrir?
artworks.description: This is an interior scene drawing depicting a legal setting. In the foreground, there is a table with an individual writing on paper while conversing with another person. Another person is standing nearby. In the background, there are onlookers or officials near a wall decorated with posters displaying text. The drawing uses tonal contrasts to express period-specific attire and character expressions. The scene conveys a sense of gravity and everyday urgency, reflective of an environment focused on issues of law and justice.

artworks.title: Un Avocat qui est... rempli de la conviction... intime...
artworks.description: The image shows a courtroom scene with five figures. One person to the right stands with their arm extended, while another person to the left stands in profile. Two seated individuals face away from the viewer, and two more individuals, possibly seated behind a bench, are shown at a higher elevation. The background features a plain, textured backdrop typical of an indoor courtroom environment.

artworks.title: Allons donc, chers confrères...
artworks.description: The image shows three men conversing. They are wearing long robes and tall hats. The men appear to be engaged in discussion, with one speaking and the others listening attentively. They have distinct facial features and expressive gestures. The men wear dark clothing with light collars. One man holds a folded document or book. The background is plain with light shading.

artworks.title: Comme je vous ai dit vertement votre fait!
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in conversation. They are standing facing each other, each with one arm extended. Both men have distinct facial features; the man on the left has shorter hair, while the man on the right has wavy or curly hair. They are wearing long, dark robes and square hats. The man on the right is holding a small circular object close to his chest. The background consists of a lightly textured wall on the right and a simple floor pattern. Text is visible at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Vous m'avez injurié dans votre plaidoirie...
artworks.description: The image depicts five men engaged in discussion. One man on the left is turned slightly to the side wearing a long coat and hat. The other four men face each other in a semicircle, all dressed in traditional judicial attire with flat-topped hats. The men have serious expressions, one appearing particularly concerned. Some are holding documents. The background is plain and the drawing style is caricature-like with exaggerated facial expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Et parlant a sa portière ainsi déclarée...
artworks.description: The image features an illustration depicting three individuals. Two men in 19th-century attire and a woman in traditional clothing. The men are shown in profile, one holding a piece of paper, and the other holding a thin object. The woman is standing in a doorway, wearing a shawl and a head covering. The setting is a simple room with part of an exterior wall visible, with the word "Parles" partially shown. Text at the top and bottom of the image suggests it is part of a publication.
